sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场，采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilron Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔龙·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, foreign service agents often serve for decades, carrying their knowledge and relationships from one administration to the next.
sentences.zh: 今天，外事服务人员通常服务数十年，将他们的知识和人脉从一个政府带到下一个政府。

sentences.en: But in a few short months, a new boss has fired or driven out many of the country's most experienced diplomats.
sentences.zh: 但在短短几个月内，一位新老板解雇或逼走了许多国家最有经验的外交官。

sentences.en: The state of the State Department under Rex Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森领导下的国务院现状。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月20日，星期五。

sentences.en: You mind if I record?
sentences.zh: 你介意我录音吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Jason Zangerly recently sat down with Secretary of State Rex Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 杰森·赞格利最近与国务卿雷克斯·蒂勒森进行了深入交谈。

sentences.en: He's big.
sentences.zh: 他气场很大。

sentences.en: You know, he's somewhat, you know, sort of barely.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他有点那种，几乎可以说是……

sentences.en: His hair is, you know, combed back in this kind of Master of the Universe style.
sentences.zh: 他的头发，你知道，往后梳着，有一种“宇宙主宰”的风格。

sentences.en: And he's got this voice.
sentences.zh: 而且他有着这样一副嗓音。

sentences.en: Well, there's a lot of things going on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多事情正在发生。

sentences.en: He's just got this kind of deep baritone with this Texas accent.
sentences.zh: 他就是那种带着德克萨斯口音的低沉男低音。

sentences.en: And it really radiates a kind of charisma and authority.
sentences.zh: 这确实散发着一种个人魅力和威严。

sentences.en: His presence is one you feel when you're in it.
sentences.zh: 当你身处其境时，你能真切感受到他的存在感。

sentences.en: Take a map of the world out, throw a dart.
sentences.zh: 拿出一张世界地图，随便扔个飞镖。

sentences.en: Did you just get back from the White House?
sentences.zh: 你刚从白宫回来吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I had some lunch.
sentences.zh: 对，我吃了个午饭。

sentences.en: Got back, had lunch.
sentences.zh: 回来了，吃过午饭。

sentences.en: But yeah, I was over there for a couple of hours.
sentences.zh: 不过对，我在那边待了几个小时。

sentences.en: So Tillerson's different from other cabinet members in the White House.
sentences.zh: 所以蒂勒森和白宫的其他内阁成员不同。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: I mean, how does he stand out?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他有何出众之处？

sentences.en: Well, he has a real record of accomplishment in the business world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他在商界有着真正的卓越政绩。

sentences.en: Tillerson, he started at Exxon as, right out of college, right out of the University of Texas, as an engineer.
sentences.zh: 蒂勒森一毕业就加入了埃克森美孚，刚从德克萨斯大学毕业，作为一名工程师。

sentences.en: And he spent 41 years there and worked his way up the ladder to eventually become CEO.
sentences.zh: 他在那里度过了41年，一步步往上爬，最终成为首席执行官。

sentences.en: I had a fantastic 41 and a half year career at Exxon.
sentences.zh: 我在埃克森度过了极其精彩的41年半的职业生涯。

sentences.en: I'm the most blessed person on planet Earth.
sentences.zh: 我是地球上最受眷顾的人。

sentences.en: Loved every minute of it.
sentences.zh: 热爱其中的每一分钟。

sentences.en: Trump was really enamored of the idea that ExxonMobil was in the toughest places in the world.
sentences.zh: 特朗普非常着迷于这样一个想法：埃克森美孚一直在世界上最艰难的地方开展业务。

sentences.en: And Tillerson was dealing with the toughest people and getting the best of them in his negotiations.
sentences.zh: 而蒂勒森一直在和最难缠的人打交道，并在谈判中占得先机。

sentences.en: And Trump really, he wanted, he thought those skill sets could really be brought to bear for his administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普确实希望，他认为这些技能可以真正为他的政府所用。

sentences.en: I do think Trump was impressed that he was a self-made man.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为特朗普对他是白手起家这一点印象深刻。

sentences.en: And what do you mean by self-made man?
sentences.zh: 你所说的白手起家是什么意思？

sentences.en: He grew up, his father worked for the Boy Scouts.
sentences.zh: 他长大的时候，他父亲为童军工作。

sentences.en: He, you know, did not grow up rich.
sentences.zh: 他，你知道，并非出身富裕。

sentences.en: He went to the University of Texas as an engineer and started as an engineer and then climbed his way up the corporate ladder and became a multimillionaire.
sentences.zh: 他作为一名工程师进入德克萨斯大学，从工程师做起，然后沿着公司阶梯一步步往上爬，成了一名千万富翁。

sentences.en: He's not someone who started with the advantages that, say, you know, Donald Trump or Steve Mnuchin had.
sentences.zh: 他可不是那种一开始就拥有唐纳德·特朗普或史蒂夫·姆努钦那样优势的人。

sentences.en: He really, he really was a self-creation.
sentences.zh: 他真的是完全靠自己创造出来的。

sentences.en: Well, you probably know the story.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可能知道这个故事。

sentences.en: He and I had never met before the day he asked me to do this.
sentences.zh: 在他要求我做这件事的那天之前，我和他从未见过面。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So remind us how Tillerson got this coveted position, arguably the most prestigious cabinet position in any White House secretary of state.
sentences.zh: 那么请提醒我们，蒂勒森是如何获得这个令人艳羡的职位——可以说是任何白宫国务卿中最具声望的内阁职位的？

sentences.en: Why, why him?
sentences.zh: 为什么，为什么是他？

sentences.en: Well, Trump, I think, was having a real difficult time deciding who he wanted for the job.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为特朗普在决定谁来担任这个职位时遇到了很大的困难。

sentences.en: You know, in the initial days, some of the people being mentioned were John Bolton and Newt Gingrich and Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在最初几天，被提及的一些人包括约翰·博尔顿、纽特·金里奇和鲁迪·朱利安尼。

sentences.en: You know, they were all three were quite strident critics of the State Department.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这三个人都是国务院相当尖锐的批评者。

sentences.en: So the idea that they would then be running it would be troubling, I think, for people there.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们去管理国务院的想法，我认为对那里的人来说会感到不安。

sentences.en: And then right around that time, he had a meeting with Robert Gates, who was the secretary of defense under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 然后就在那个时候，他会见了罗伯特·盖茨，他是奥巴马总统任内的国防部长。

sentences.en: And Gates had been quite critical of Trump during the campaign, as many mainstream Republicans had been.
sentences.zh: 盖茨在竞选期间曾对特朗普提出严厉批评，就像许多主流共和党人一样。

sentences.en: But Trump saw him nonetheless, and it was during that meeting at Trump Tower that Gates recommended Tillerson for the job of secretary of state.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普还是见了他，正是在特朗普大厦的那次会面中，盖茨向特朗普推荐了蒂勒森担任国务卿一职。

sentences.en: Well, I know a number of former secretary of states well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我和几位前国务卿都很熟。

sentences.en: I've known Jim Baker for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 我和吉姆·贝克认识很多很多年了。

sentences.en: Condoleezza Rice and I have been friends for a long time.
sentences.zh: 康多莉扎·赖斯和我做朋友已经很久了。

sentences.en: I mean, I know essentially all of the living secretary of states.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基本上所有健在的国务卿我都认识。

sentences.en: But Gates had worked as a consultant for ExxonMobil, along with Condoleezza Rice, who also around the same time was recommending Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 但盖茨曾担任埃克森美孚的顾问，差不多同一时期，康多莉扎·赖斯也推荐了蒂勒森。

sentences.en: So based on those recommendations, Trump reached out to Tillerson's people and invited him up to New York for a meeting.
sentences.zh: 因此，基于这些推荐，特朗普联系了蒂勒森的人，邀请他去纽约开会。

sentences.en: As I understand it, Tillerson thought he was going up just to talk about foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，蒂勒森以为自己去只是为了谈论外交政策。

sentences.en: He did not realize that he was going up to be interviewed to be secretary of state.
sentences.zh: 他没有意识到自己是去接受国务卿职位的面试。

sentences.en: And in their first meeting at Trump Tower, I think it went two hours, which is an eternity for a meeting for President Trump.
sentences.zh: 在他们于特朗普大厦的第一次会面中，我想持续了两个小时，这对于特朗普总统的会议来说简直是永恒。

sentences.en: Trump was just blown away by Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 特朗普完全被蒂勒森折服了。

sentences.en: I talked to Steve Bannon and he said that as soon as Tillerson walked in the door, as soon as Bannon saw Tillerson, you know, he could see his presence, his charisma.
sentences.zh: 我跟史蒂夫·班农聊过，他说蒂勒森一走进门，班农一看到蒂勒森，你知道，他就能看出他的气场、他的魅力。

sentences.en: And he knows how much first impressions matter to Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且他知道第一印象对特朗普有多重要。

sentences.en: And he said he knew as soon as Tillerson walked in the door that he had the job.
sentences.zh: 他说他一看到蒂勒森进门就知道他得到了这份工作。

sentences.en: Meaning that Trump had a physical vision of what his secretary of state might look like and sound like.
sentences.zh: 这意味着特朗普对他的国务卿的外表和声音有着某种具象的想象。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: And if he didn't have a physical vision before, he did after he saw Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 如果他之前没有这种具象想象，在见到蒂勒森之后就有了。

sentences.en: Apparently, he offered him the job in the interview.
sentences.zh: 显然，他在面试中就向他提供了这份工作。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Towards the end of my career, President Trump-elect presents me with this.
sentences.zh: 在我的职业生涯接近尾声时，当选总统特朗普向我抛出了这个。

sentences.en: You know, that's when my wife made me realize that I hadn't done anything yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是我的妻子让我意识到我其实什么还没做。

sentences.en: And she said, look, you've been training for this for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 她说，听着，你为了这个已经训练了40年。

sentences.en: You got to go do it.
sentences.zh: 你必须去把它做好。

sentences.en: I mean, you could argue that Tillerson in some ways had a leg up over his predecessors in terms of what he knew about the world, at least parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以认为蒂勒森在某些方面比他的前任们更有优势，就他对世界的了解而言，至少是对世界某些地区的了解而言。

sentences.en: You know, he had deep experience in the Middle East and in Africa and in Latin America, given the work he'd done there on behalf of ExxonMobil.
sentences.zh: 你知道，鉴于他在埃克森美孚代表公司所做的工作，他在中东、非洲和拉丁美洲拥有丰富的经验。

sentences.en: But he knew absolutely nothing about the State Department itself or even government.
sentences.zh: 但他对国务院本身甚至对政府一无所知。

sentences.en: There's a real sense inside the State Department and among Foreign Service officers that Tillerson has no use for their expertise.
sentences.zh: 国务院内部和外交服务官员中有一种强烈的看法，认为蒂勒森根本不需要他们的专业知识。

sentences.en: And then, in fact, he's, you know, he's contemptuous of it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他，你知道，他对这些不屑一顾。

sentences.en: Tell me about Nancy McEldowney.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲南希·麦克多劳尼。

sentences.en: She was a career Foreign Service person.
sentences.zh: 她是一名职业外交服务人员。

sentences.en: I think she'd been in for 30 years.
sentences.zh: 我想她已经在职30年了。

sentences.en: And when Tillerson came in, she at that time was running the Foreign Service Institute, which is where Foreign Service officers go for training.
sentences.zh: 当蒂勒森上任时，她当时正负责管理外事服务学院，那是外事服务官员接受培训的地方。

sentences.en: So she, in some ways, was sort of the academic dean of the Foreign Service.
sentences.zh: 所以她在某种程度上可以说是外交部门的学术院长。

sentences.en: I come from a military family.
sentences.zh: 我来自一个军人家庭。

sentences.en: My father was a Marine.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是一名海军陆战队员。

sentences.en: My husband and brother were Air Force officers.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫和弟弟都是空军军官。

sentences.en: Patriotism and public service is something that we all care very deeply about.
sentences.zh: 爱国主义和公共服务是我们所有人都非常关切的事情。

sentences.en: I used to pinch myself and say, I can't believe they pay me to do this, because I got to do things that I was really passionate about.
sentences.zh: 我过去常常掐自己一下，说，我不敢相信他们付钱让我做这个，因为我得以从事我真正充满热情的工作。

sentences.en: I got to learn new languages, live in different countries around the world, meet fascinating people, and work on things that really mattered.
sentences.zh: 我有机会学习新的语言，在世界不同的国家生活，结识迷人的人，并从事真正重要的事情。

sentences.en: And what year did you start at the State Department?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候开始在国务院工作的？

sentences.en: Actually, I started under President Reagan in 1986 as a Presidential Management Fellow.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我是在1986年里根总统任内作为总统管理研究员开始的。

sentences.en: And then two years later, I entered the Foreign Service.
sentences.zh: 两年后，我进入了外事服务部门。

sentences.en: When you learned that Rex Tillerson was going to be your new boss, the new Secretary of State, what were your first thoughts about that?
sentences.zh: 当你得知雷克斯·蒂勒森将成为你的新老板、新国务卿时，你对此的第一想法是什么？

sentences.en: When Rex Tillerson was first appointed, all of us were a bit surprised.
sentences.zh: 当雷克斯·蒂勒森刚被任命时，我们所有人都感到有点惊讶。

sentences.en: He had never worked foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 他从未涉足过外交政策。

sentences.en: He did not know how government process works.
sentences.zh: 他不知道政府程序是如何运作的。

sentences.en: And he didn't have relationships, really, of any kind with people in the White House or with other members of the Cabinet.
sentences.zh: 而且他与白宫的人或内阁其他成员基本上没有任何形式的人脉关系。

sentences.en: So on those three key areas of policy, process, and people, he was starting behind the curve.
sentences.zh: 所以在政策、程序和人员这三个关键领域上，他起步时就落后了。

sentences.en: And then what was your experience once he actually started the job?
sentences.zh: 那么在他真正开始工作后，你的经历是怎样的？

sentences.en: Rex Tillerson came in and made an initial very positive impression.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森上任之初留下了非常积极的印象。

sentences.en: He appeared to reach out to the workforce of the Department of State, and so people were very optimistic.
sentences.zh: 他似乎主动接触国务院的工作人员，所以人们非常乐观。

sentences.en: That optimism did not last long, however.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种乐观并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, from the beginning, when we got word that senior people were being fired without any notice or any justification,
sentences.zh: 嗯，从一开始，当我们听到高级官员在没有任何通知或任何正当理由的情况下被解雇时，

sentences.en: and there were waves of removals where our senior most officials, the people that we were working for and taking guidance from,
sentences.zh: 并且有一波波的撤职潮，我们最高级别的官员，那些我们为其工作并接受其指导的人，

sentences.en: were told after decades of loyal public service, they had 24 or 48 hours to clear out their offices.
sentences.zh: 在数十年忠诚的公共服务之后，被告知只有24小时或48小时来清理他们的办公室。

sentences.en: That, of course, is deeply demoralizing for everyone who worked with and under those individuals.
sentences.zh: 这当然对所有与这些人共事和在其手下工作的人来说是沉重的打击士气的事。

sentences.en: But then when the decision came that our budget was going to be cut by one-third or that a chokehold was going to be put on our recruitment programs,
sentences.zh: 但随后当决定出台，我们的预算将被削减三分之一，或者我们的招聘计划将被勒令卡死时，

sentences.en: and people started to ask questions, why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 人们开始提出疑问，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why are these things being done?
sentences.zh: 为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: And no answer was provided or no coherent answer.
sentences.zh: 却没有得到任何答复，或者没有得到连贯的答复。

sentences.en: And how did the changes under Tillerson affect you personally?
sentences.zh: 蒂勒森时期的变化对你个人有什么影响？

sentences.en: One immediate impact is that my budget was cut.
sentences.zh: 一个直接的影响是我的预算被削减了。

sentences.en: I was told that I could not hire anyone, even when I had vacant positions.
sentences.zh: 我被告知不能雇用任何人，即使我有空缺职位。

sentences.en: I could not transfer people within my organization or from elsewhere inside the State Department.
sentences.zh: 我不能在我的组织内部或从国务院内部的其他地方调动人员。

sentences.en: But I was also told that I could make no reference to the policies of the prior administration.
sentences.zh: 但我还被告知，我不得提及上一届政府的政策。

sentences.en: Wait, what?
sentences.zh: 等等，什么？

sentences.en: We were told that memos that would go forward could not reference the policies of the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知，提交的备忘录不能提及奥巴马政府的政策。

sentences.en: There was a political appointee sent out to the Foreign Service Institute who reviewed our training materials
sentences.zh: 有一个政治任命人员被派到外事服务学院审查我们的培训材料，

sentences.en: and objected when there was reference to American foreign policy under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 当材料中提及奥巴马政府时期的美国外交政策时，他提出了异议。

sentences.en: Why do you think that was?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: I think it was simply an attempt to state that history started on the day the Trump administration walked into office.
sentences.zh: 我认为这纯粹是试图宣称历史是从特朗普政府上台的那一天开始的。

sentences.en: Our response was that we were not rewriting history.
sentences.zh: 我们的回应是，我们并没有重写历史。

sentences.en: We would indeed continue to teach our diplomats what policy under all previous presidents had been,
sentences.zh: 我们确实会继续教导我们的外交官历届总统时期的政策是什么样的，

sentences.en: and that when the Trump administration developed a policy toward different parts of the world, we would teach that as well.
sentences.zh: 并且当特朗普政府制定针对世界不同地区的政策时，我们也会教授这些。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: We were told when our materials were reviewed that we should not feature or include materials that discussed the policies of the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 我们的材料在接受审查时被告知，我们不应该突出显示或包含讨论奥巴马政府政策的材料。

sentences.en: I objected to that and refused to oblige.
sentences.zh: 对此我提出了异议，并拒绝顺从。

sentences.en: And what happened when you refused to oblige?
sentences.zh: 当你拒绝顺从时发生了什么？

sentences.en: I decided to leave in June of this year.
sentences.zh: 我决定在今年6月离开。

sentences.en: I went through a period of weeks and months of soul-searching, of consulting with family and trusted friends, of talking with colleagues.
sentences.zh: 我经历了数周和数月的内心挣扎、与家人和可信赖的朋友商讨、与同事交谈。

sentences.en: None of us, myself and others who have left or are in the process of leaving, we didn't want to leave.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人，包括我和其他已经离开或正在离开的人，我们并不想离开。

sentences.en: We wanted to continue to serve our country, but we had to stay true to our values.
sentences.zh: 我们希望继续为国家服务，但我们必须忠于我们的价值观。

sentences.en: So you decided that you couldn't do the job that you had come to do, and that's when you decided to leave.
sentences.zh: 所以你认为你无法完成你原本要做的工作，这就是你决定离开的原因。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: My effectiveness and the effectiveness of my organization was greatly diminished.
sentences.zh: 我和我的组织的工作效率大大降低了。

sentences.en: It's like the diplomatic equivalent of an earthquake or a fire.
sentences.zh: 这就像是外交界的地震或火灾。

sentences.en: When there is a crisis and people will say, where are the firemen?
sentences.zh: 当发生危机时，人们会问，消防员在哪里？

sentences.en: Where are the first responders?
sentences.zh: 第一响应者在哪里？

sentences.en: And the response will have to be, oh, we decided to get rid of them in a budget-cutting exercise.
sentences.zh: 而回应必然是，哦，我们在削减预算时决定把他们裁掉了。

sentences.en: Because when you think about what America's diplomats do, we are essentially the first line of defense for our country around the world.
sentences.zh: 因为当你思考美国外交官的作用时，我们实际上是我们在世界各地的一线防御力量。

sentences.en: We provide the early warning indications.
sentences.zh: 我们提供早期预警迹象。

sentences.en: If a conflict is going to break out, we help build coalitions.
sentences.zh: 如果冲突即将爆发，我们协助建立联盟。

sentences.en: We negotiate agreements on everything from counterterrorism to preventing the proliferation of dangerous weapons.
sentences.zh: 我们从反恐到防止危险武器扩散等各个领域谈判达成协议。

sentences.en: And without that first line of defense, America is weaker and more vulnerable, and the world is more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 没有了这第一道防线，美国将变得更加软弱和脆弱，世界也将更加危险。

sentences.en: My colleague, Jason, spoke with Secretary Tillerson recently in his office and asked him if he was trying to dismantle the Foreign Service.
sentences.zh: 我的同事杰森最近在办公室采访了蒂勒森国务卿，并问他是否试图解散外交服务部门。

sentences.en: A question that I've been hearing a lot, talking to people in the building and outside,
sentences.zh: 这个问题我听过很多次，无论是在大楼内部还是外部与人们交谈时，

sentences.en: are you trying to dismantle or hollow out the Foreign Service?
sentences.zh: 你们是在试图解散还是掏空外交服务部门？

sentences.en: And Tillerson said...
sentences.zh: 蒂勒森说……

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.zh: 远非如此。

sentences.en: No, I mean, in the time, you know, and I knew this coming into the position,
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，在这段时间里，你知道，我来的时候就知道这一点，

sentences.en: but I've gained even a greater appreciation for it since I got here in terms of the level of expertise that people in the Foreign Service have, but also the civil servants here.
sentences.zh: 但自从我来到这里，对于外交服务人员以及这里的公务员所拥有的专业水平，我有了更深的感激。

sentences.en: You know, everyone has their role to play.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每个人都有自己的角色要扮演。

sentences.en: Do you understand at all why that perception exists?
sentences.zh: 你完全理解为什么会有这种看法吗？

sentences.en: I mean, can you, are there things that you've done that you could see as feeding that perception?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你能，你做过的事有哪些可能会被认为助长了这种看法？

sentences.en: No, I'm mystified by it.
sentences.zh: 不，我对此感到迷惑不解。

sentences.en: I really am.
sentences.zh: 我真的感到很困惑。

sentences.en: Do you, and from your conversations with your former colleagues, do they think that Secretary Tillerson is in some ways trying to dismantle the Foreign Service?
sentences.zh: 你，根据你与前同事们的交谈，他们是否认为蒂勒森国务卿在某种程度上正试图解散外交服务部门？

sentences.en: What I heard throughout my tenure while I was there and what I have heard subsequently is rhetoric,
sentences.zh: 我在任期间听到的一切以及后来听到的一直是这种说辞，

sentences.en: which says we're trying to make the State Department more effective.
sentences.zh: 即我们正试图让国务院更有效率。

sentences.en: But what undermines that rhetoric and causes people not to trust it is the fact that there's no vision, no clarity about what they believe the State Department should be doing,
sentences.zh: 但破坏这种说辞并导致人们不再信任它的事实是，没有任何愿景，没有明确表明他们认为国务院应该做什么，

sentences.en: what capabilities and functions should it be performing.
sentences.zh: 它应该履行哪些能力和职能。

sentences.en: The idea that there's some sort of grand strategy behind this, some vision for the role that the Department of State will play in executing the Trump administration policy,
sentences.zh: 认为这背后有什么宏伟战略的想法，对于国务院在执行特朗普政府政策中将发挥的作用有什么愿景，

sentences.en: none of that is there.
sentences.zh: 这些通通都没有。

sentences.en: All we see are budget cuts, workforce reductions, suspensions of longstanding, greatly cherished prograMs.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的只有预算削减、精简员工、暂停长期以来深受珍视的项目。

sentences.en: So I don't spend a lot of time listening to rumor or conjuring up wild theories, but I'm confused.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会花很多时间去听信谣言或凭空捏造狂野的理论，但我确实很困惑。

sentences.en: What direction does Rex Tillerson think he is taking the State Department in that will prove to be in any way positive?
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森认为他正引导国务院走向哪个方向，才能证明这是任何形式的积极方向？

sentences.en: I'm an engineer by training.
sentences.zh: 我受过工程师训练。

sentences.en: I'm a very systems, process, methodical decision maker.
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常注重系统、流程、有条理的决策者。

sentences.en: He's an entrepreneur, different mindset.
sentences.zh: 他是一名企业家，有着不同的思维方式。

sentences.en: He makes decisions differently.
sentences.zh: 他做决定的方式不同。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean one's better than the other.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着一种比另一种更好。

sentences.en: But I've had to learn how he processes information and how I can give him good advice that makes sense to him.
sentences.zh: 但我不得不去了解他如何处理信息，以及我如何能向他提供对大局有意义的好的建议。

sentences.en: So Jason, what have you learned about how both the president and Tillerson are thinking about the State Department?
sentences.zh: 所以杰森，你对总统和蒂勒森如何看待国务院有什么了解？

sentences.en: Trump, I gather, in a number of his meetings, both with Tillerson, with Mattis, with other national security officials,
sentences.zh: 据我所知，特朗普在与蒂勒森、马蒂斯以及其他国家安全官员的多次会晤中，

sentences.en: had expressed a lot of skepticism and confusion about why America was in all of these places.
sentences.zh: 对美国为什么要在所有这些地方驻留表达了很大的怀疑和困惑。

sentences.en: Why do we have military assets?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们要有军事资产？

sentences.en: Why do you have diplomatic assets?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们要有外交资产？

sentences.en: Why do you have intelligence assets in all these places?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们在所有这些地方都有情报资产？

sentences.en: So finally in July, Mattis and Tillerson and some other national security officials set up a meeting with President Trump at the Pentagon,
sentences.zh: 所以最终在7月，马蒂斯、蒂勒森和其他一些国家安全官员在五角大楼与特朗普总统安排了一次会晤，

sentences.en: which the Associated Press did a great article about.
sentences.zh: 美联社对此做了一篇很棒的报道。

sentences.en: And the way the Associated Press put it was the meeting was basically a tutorial in American Power 101, just trying to answer the president's fairly elementary questions about,
sentences.zh: 美联社的表述是，这次会晤基本上是一堂美国力量101的入门课，只是试图回答总统相当基础的问题，关于，

sentences.en: why do we have bases here?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们在这里有基地？

sentences.en: Why do we have embassies in these places?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们在这些地方有大使馆？

sentences.en: And they walked him through with, you know, PowerPoint slides and maps and things like that to just kind of answer these really basic questions.
sentences.zh: 他们通过幻灯片、地图诸如此类的内容向他做了介绍，以此来回答这些非常基本的问题。

sentences.en: NBC News later reported that it was after that meeting.
sentences.zh: 美国全国广播公司新闻随后报道说，正是在那次会晤之后，

sentences.en: Rex Tillerson took the unusual step yesterday of appearing before cameras at the State Department
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·蒂勒森昨天采取了不同寻常的举动，出现在国务院的镜头前，

sentences.en: to answer questions about whether he had insulted the president and considered resigning.
sentences.zh: 以回答关于他是否侮辱了总统并考虑辞职的提问。

sentences.en: That Tillerson voiced his assessment that...
sentences.zh: 即蒂勒森表达了他的评估，认为……

sentences.en: He called the president a moron.
sentences.zh: 他称总统为笨蛋。

sentences.en: The president was a moron.
sentences.zh: 总统是个笨蛋。

sentences.en: And what was the president's reaction to that?
sentences.zh: 总统对此有何反应？

sentences.en: It was fake news.
sentences.zh: 那是假新闻。

sentences.en: It was a totally phony story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个完全虚假的故事。

sentences.en: The president called it fake news.
sentences.zh: 总统称之为假新闻。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he said that if Tillerson did say that, that they would have an IQ test and he knows who would win that one.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他说如果蒂勒森真的说过这话，他们可以进行一次智商测试，而且他知道谁会赢。

sentences.en: And Jason, to answer the question that the president seemed to be posing in that meeting, why does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 杰森，为了回答总统似乎在那次会晤中提出的问题，为什么美国

sentences.en: have these bases and embassies all over the place?
sentences.zh: 要在世界各地设立这些基地和大使馆？

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: The message that, as I understand it, the message that Tillerson and Mattis and others gave to the president
sentences.zh: 据我所知，蒂勒森、马蒂斯和其他人向总统传递的信息是，

sentences.en: was we have these bases and these embassies and the like to help American businesses in their work abroad
sentences.zh: 我们拥有这些基地、大使馆以及类似设施，是为了在海外工作时帮助美国企业，

sentences.en: because they thought that was a message that would resonate with President Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为他们认为这个信息会引起特朗普总统的共鸣。

sentences.en: You know, of course, that's only part of it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当然，这只是其中一部分。

sentences.en: I mean, we have these bases.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们有这些基地。

sentences.en: We have these embassies because we are the linchpin of global stability.
sentences.zh: 我们有这些大使馆，因为我们是全球稳定的基石。

sentences.en: And that's the way it's been for more than the last half century.
sentences.zh: 过去半个多世纪以来一直如此。

sentences.en: And without the United States in these places, I think there's the fear that it will be chaos.
sentences.zh: 如果没有美国在这些地方，我担心会出现混乱。

sentences.en: And I think Tillerson himself believes that.
sentences.zh: 我想蒂勒森本人也是这么认为的。

sentences.en: But given the administration he's working in and given some of his own, I think, blind spots in terms of how he's doing his job, that's now being called into question.
sentences.zh: 但鉴于他所效力的政府，以及鉴于他在如何履行职责方面的一些盲点，这一点现在受到了质疑。

sentences.en: But President Trump's foreign policy goals break the mold of what people traditionally think is achievable on behalf of our country.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统的外交政策目标打破了人们传统上认为可以代表我国实现的目标的条条框框。

sentences.en: We're finding new ways to govern that deliver new victories.
sentences.zh: 我们正在寻找带来新胜利的治理新途径。

sentences.en: Jason, you probably watched this news conference, I did, where Tillerson came out at the State Department
sentences.zh: 杰森，你大概看了这场新闻发布会，我也看了，蒂勒森在国务院公开露面，

sentences.en: and seemed to basically pledge his loyalty to Trump and to talk about his admiration for Trump.
sentences.zh: 似乎基本上宣誓效忠特朗普，并谈到了他对特朗普的钦佩。

sentences.en: What did you think when you watched that?
sentences.zh: 你看到那个的时候是怎么想的？

sentences.en: What did you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I saw a guy who knew that his boss was on an airplane going to Las Vegas and knew that the
sentences.zh: 我看到一个人，他知道他的老板在一架去拉斯维加斯的飞机上，并且知道

sentences.en: TVs were going to be on on that airplane and wanted to make sure that his boss saw him pledge his loyalty.
sentences.zh: 那架飞机上的电视将会开着，他想确保他的老板看到他宣誓效忠。

sentences.en: Let me tell you what I've learned about this president whom I did not know before taking this office.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你我对这位总统的了解，在就职之前我并不认识他。

sentences.en: He loves his country.
sentences.zh: 他热爱他的国家。

sentences.en: He puts Americans and America firSt.
sentences.zh: 他把美国人和美国放在第一位。

sentences.en: He's smart.
sentences.zh: 他很聪明。

sentences.en: One of the weirder press conferences I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是我见过最诡异的新闻发布会之一。

sentences.en: I mean, the place where he had it, it's a room actually right outside where I met with Tillerson.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他举办发布会的那个地方，其实就在我与蒂勒森会面房间的外面。

sentences.en: It's this reception room where Tillerson, every secretary of state traditionally, that's where they meet with foreign leaders.
sentences.zh: 这是一个接待室，蒂勒森，每一位历任国务卿，都是在那里会见外国领导人的。

sentences.en: To see him having to field a question about whether he called the president a moron, it was really surreal.
sentences.zh: 看到他不得不回答关于他是否称总统为笨蛋的提问，这真的太超现实了。

sentences.en: The president likes to communicate directly with the world in these very unmediated ways on social media,
sentences.zh: 总统喜欢通过社交媒体以这种非常不经中介的方式与世界直接沟通，

sentences.en: and that appears to have been a source of some tension with the secretary of state.
sentences.zh: 这似乎已成为与国务卿产生某些紧张关系的根源。

sentences.en: How does Tillerson talk about that to you, and how does he incorporate that into his job?
sentences.zh: 蒂勒森是如何向你谈论这一点的，他又如何将这一点融入他的工作中的？

sentences.en: It was really fascinating to hear him refer to President Trump's tweets as this sort of unknown external factor.
sentences.zh: 听到他将特朗普总统的推文称为这种未知的外部因素，真的非常着迷。

sentences.en: Look, on the president's tweets, and I've said this to many people before, I take what the president tweets out as his form of communicating,
sentences.zh: 听着，关于总统的推文，我以前对很多人说过，我把总统发推文视为他的一种沟通方式，

sentences.en: and I build it into my strategies and my tactics.
sentences.zh: 并把它融入到我的策略和战术中。

sentences.en: How can I use that?
sentences.zh: 我该如何利用这一点？

sentences.en: How do I want to use that?
sentences.zh: 我想如何利用这一点？

sentences.en: So how do you use that?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何利用这一点呢？

sentences.en: And in a dynamic situation, like we deal with here all the time, and you can go walk around the world, they're all dynamic.
sentences.zh: 在动态的情况下，就像我们这里一直在处理的那样，你可以去世界各地看看，它们都是动态的。

sentences.en: Things happen.
sentences.zh: 事情会发生。

sentences.en: Things – you wake up the next morning, something's happened.
sentences.zh: 事情——你第二天醒来，事情已经发生了。

sentences.en: The president's got a tweet out there.
sentences.zh: 总统发了一条推文。

sentences.en: So I think about, okay, that's a new condition.
sentences.zh: 所以我思考，好吧，这是一个新情况。

sentences.en: How do I want to use that?
sentences.zh: 我想如何利用这一点？

sentences.en: As best you can tell, Jason, does Rex Tillerson want to be Donald Trump's secretary of state?
sentences.zh: 据你所知，杰森，雷克斯·蒂勒森想当唐纳德·特朗普的国务卿吗？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: I don't think he wants to be a failure at this point.
sentences.zh: 我认为他此时不想成为一个失败者。

sentences.en: I don't know if he necessarily wants to be Trump's secretary of state, but I don't think he wants to leave under the cloud that he's currently operating under.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是否一定想当特朗普的国务卿，但我认为他不想带着目前笼罩着他的阴云离开。

sentences.en: In some ways, if he did want to leave before,
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，如果他以前确实想离开，

sentences.en: the events of the last few weeks have made his departure in some ways less attractive to him because the circumstances around it would be so damaging to his own personal legacy.
sentences.zh: 过去几周发生的事件在某种程度上让他的离职变得没那么吸引人了，因为周围的环境对他的个人政治遗产破坏太大了。

sentences.en: He's really – he's digging in in some ways.
sentences.zh: 他真的——在某些方面他在坚守阵地。

sentences.en: He wants to reestablish and prove his value to Trump.
sentences.zh: 他想重新确立并证明他对特朗普的价值。

sentences.en: Is America's chief diplomat's biggest job right now forging diplomacy with his boss?
sentences.zh: 美国最高外交官目前最重要的工作是与他的老板建立外交关系吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: And it's his most difficult job.
sentences.zh: 这也是他最困难的工作。

sentences.en: Jason, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 杰森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Oh, thanks so much for having me on.
sentences.zh: 哦，非常感谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: For more of Jason's interview with Rex Tillerson, listen to this weekend's episode of our other podcast, The New Washington.
sentences.zh: 要收听杰森对雷克斯·蒂勒森采访的更多内容，请收听本周末我们的另一个播客节目《新华盛顿》。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁的？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: So I just wanted to perhaps make more of a statement.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想也许发表更多声明。

sentences.en: On Thursday afternoon, White House Chief of Staff John Kelly walked into the White House briefing room for an unscheduled speech.
sentences.zh: 周四下午，白宫办公厅主任约翰·凯利走进白宫简报室发表了一场未安排的演讲。

sentences.en: Most Americans don't know what happens when we lose one of our soldiers, sailors, airmen, marines, or coast guardsmen in combat.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国人并不知道当我们的一名士兵、水手、飞行员、海军陆战队员或海岸警卫队员在战斗中牺牲时会发生什么。

sentences.en: So let me tell you what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以让我告诉你发生了什么。

sentences.en: Their buddies wrap them up in whatever passes as a shroud, puts them on a helicopter as a routine, and sends them home.
sentences.zh: 他们的同伴用任何当作裹尸布的东西把他们包起来，按惯例把他们放到直升机上，然后送他们回家。

sentences.en: In emotional remarks, Kelly defended Trump's phone call to the widow of a U.S.
sentences.zh: 在情绪激动的发言中，凯利为特朗普致电在尼日尔阵亡的一名美国士兵拉戴维·约翰逊的遗孀进行了辩护。

sentences.en: soldier killed in Niger, LeDavid Johnson.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊的遗孀迈莎几天前批评总统告诉她，她的丈夫，引述，“知道他报名时意味着什么”。

sentences.en: Days after Johnson's widow, Maisha, criticized the president for telling her that her husband, quote, knew what he was signing up for.
sentences.zh: 打那通电话没有完美的方式。

sentences.en: There's no perfect way to make that phone call.
sentences.zh: 当我接受这份工作并与特朗普总统谈论如何去做时，我的第一个建议是他不要打这个电话。

sentences.en: When I took this job and talked to President Trump about how to do it, my first recommendation was he not do it.
sentences.zh: 因为这不是父母、家庭成员所期待的电话。

sentences.en: Because it's not the phone call that parents, family members are looking forward to.
sentences.zh: 凯利是一名退休将军，他回忆起自己的儿子罗伯特·凯利中尉于2010年在阿富汗阵亡的经历，

sentences.en: Kelly, a retired general, recalled the death of his own son, Second Lieutenant Robert Kelly, who was killed in Afghanistan in 2010,
sentences.zh: 并表示他从未接到过时任总统奥巴马的慰问电话。

sentences.en: saying he never received a condolence call from then-President Obama.
sentences.zh: 那不是批评。

sentences.en: That was not a criticism.
sentences.zh: 那只是简单地说，我不相信奥巴马总统打过电话。

sentences.en: That was just to simply say, I don't believe President Obama called.
sentences.zh: 这不是一件负面的事情。

sentences.en: That's not a negative thing.
sentences.zh: 我不相信布什总统在所有情况下都打过电话。

sentences.en: I don't believe President Bush called in all cases.
sentences.zh: 我不相信任何总统，特别是当伤亡率非常非常高的时候，总统会打电话。

sentences.en: I don't believe any president, particularly when the casualty rates are very, very high, that presidents call.
sentences.zh: 但我相信他们都做得对。

sentences.en: But I believe they're all right.
sentences.zh: 凯利表示，他对针对特朗普的批评感到心碎，并点名了来自佛罗里达州的国会众议员弗雷德丽卡·威尔逊，

sentences.en: Kelly said he was heartbroken by the criticism of Trump and singled out Congresswoman Frederica Wilson of Florida,
sentences.zh: 她曾表示自己听到了特朗普与约翰逊遗孀的通话，并形容该通话麻木不仁。

sentences.en: who said she heard Trump's call with Johnson's widow and described it as insensitive.
sentences.zh: 当我听这个女人以及她在电视上说的话和做的事时，

sentences.en: When I listened to this woman and what she was saying and what she was doing on TV,
sentences.zh: 我能整理思绪的唯一方法就是去走访地球上最优秀的男女官兵。

sentences.en: the only thing I could do to collect my thoughts was to go walk among the finest men and women on this earth.
sentences.zh: 我能用来理清思绪的唯一办法，就是去和这世上最优秀的人们走在一起。

sentences.en: And you can always find them, because they're in Arlington National Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 而且你总能找到他们，因为他们就在阿灵顿国家公墓。

sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个被严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的争斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和我共同主持的最新一期《Metro》节目中，萨拉·科尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: Metro。
